Covariance and variance contrast follow algebraically. The actual verifier passed 11,056 exact-rational assertions, including three-coordinate invariant-law checks; proof holds for arbitrary finite d and m, not because of finite enumeration. Neither is a dominating theorem for the joint claim. A generalized coupling theorem could imply selected steps only after specifying the shared-threshold kernel.

originality.rationale: The 2018 foundational signSGD work treats general gradient-noise convergence estimates, not the exact common-uniform-noise multivariate chain. The 2020 geometric sign-gradient study explicitly isolates geometry rather than stochastic noise. The closest published scalar uniform-noise Ehrenfest result already proves the marginal binomial distribution and parity periodicity, which are acknowledged and not claimed; its statement explicitly excludes multidimensional coupling. The new joint pure-death inter-coordinate gap, exact all-coordinate coalescence clock, parity-class stationary coupling, and stationary averaging variance do not follow from the cited scalar marginal law without analysis of the common-random-number joint transition kernel. Standard Ehrenfest and Markov-coupling textbook results give abstract tools but no particular joint sign-gradient transition or covariance statement in the inspected sections. Historical priority remains provisional due possible generic equivalent quantile couplings.
residual_risks: Historical priority is not independently established; a preexisting specialized monotone/quantile coupling of Ehrenfest urns might contain a mathematically equivalent gap-chain result under different terminology.
The correlated-noise lattice assumptions are restrictive and do not predict generic minibatch-gradient dynamics; comparisons to independent noise are within the same finite model.

value.rationale: Precisely shared stochastic gradients arise naturally when all coordinate signs use one common scalar sample. The theorem identifies an exact finite-time collapse from arbitrary dimension to one or two parity-locked values and gives the exact number-of-coordinates-independent stationary noise floor of their average. It separates marginal binomial behavior from joint dependence, a structural optimization consequence rather than a routine reparameterization or unmotivated finite table. The model restrictions and period-two caveat bound its practical interpretation.
